blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippines continues its medal campaign in the 2026 Asian Games on Saturday, September 26, as competition in Aichi-Nagoya reaches the end of its first full week. Carlo Paalam finally sees action in boxing, while Albert Ian Delos Santos looks to end the Philippines’ medal drought in weightlifting. The Blu Girls also open their campaign in women’s softball, while Filipino bets begin their competitions in archery.SOURCE: Asian Games website. Information subject to change.
